reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration that reuses local Codex CLI authentication to provide an OpenAI Codex model route, remote search, image generation and editing, usage status, and related settings.

summaries.zh: 通过复用本地 Codex CLI 登录状态，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 模型路由、远程搜索、图像生成与编辑及 GPT Auth 设置。
summaries.en: Reuses local Codex CLI login state to provide DeepSeek Harness with a Codex model route, remote search, image generation and editing, and GPT Auth settings.

capabilities: Reads and refreshes local Codex authentication state
Initiates Codex CLI browser or device-code login
Sends authenticated requests to ChatGPT Codex backend endpoints
Provides web search through the Codex service
Generates and edits images using remote Codex image endpoints
Persists generated and referenced images as conversation attachments
